fact: The African Development Bank's DIGIGOV Liberia project aimed to implement an e-payment solution hosted by the Liberia Revenue Authority to facilitate customs tax collection; the completion-report abstract states no outcomes.
The Liberia Revenue Authority says its Integrated Orange Mobile Money Platform, linked to LITAS, was launched for taxes and fees across 18 ministries and agencies, paid by USSD with an SMS receipt.
Governor Saamoi says people-to-government payment of taxes through the IIPS is ongoing with the Liberia Revenue Authority.
FrontPage Africa says work is ongoing with the Liberia Revenue Authority to roll out people-to-government payments on the IIPS.

CBL Directive 002/2025 says that from 1 December 2025 all Government of Liberia revenue collections by mobile money, including taxes, fees and levies, must be routed through NEPS/IIPS and settled into the consolidated Revenue Accounts at the CBL.
Taxpayers can pay tax through LITAS by mobile money and phone or computer, with seven of nine commercial banks connected and real-time receipts.
